author: PewDiePie69
quote: The worst protagonists the series had ever seen. The player isn't given as much freedom in this open world as previous entries in the series. Instead, that was replaced with tons of useless mini-games of simulating mundane life. The story and narrative were severely problematic and nauseating with equally disappointing and dysfunctional endings. Modern Rockstar is incapable of making a new entry in the series as they neglect the core design that made the series famous in the first place.

author: PewDiePie69
quote: Please don't waste your time and vote with your wallet. They took everything we loved in the first series. Such a letdown! I don't know what's wrong with the people who wrote the story! In my 15 years of playing, I have never been this angry and frustrated. Nonetheless, I told all my friends to refund the game and they did. I will never bite into the hype again and I will wait few days to vote with my wallet from now on.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II
